name: bnnotes
description: Obsidian-inspired Markdown Notes saved on BinaryView, w/ HLIL embedding/linking, multi-note support, and a lot of modern UI polish
longdescription:
Notes is an Obsidian-style, live-rendered Markdown notepad for Binary Ninja. Notes are saved in the BinaryView itself, so they travel with your .bndb.

![Notes beside Binary Ninja's decompiler](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0cyn/notes/main/.github/images/overview.png)

- **Code embeds:** link to a function or address with a BNURL and the note shows its HLIL, any IL level, disassembly or pseudo-code, updated as analysis changes. ⌘/Ctrl-click an embed to go there.
- **All the formatting:** headings, lists, quotes, syntax-highlighted code blocks, and editable rendered tables.
- **Authorship:** every line records who wrote it, a person or an agent, for Enterprise teams and agentic workflows.
- **Organization:** many notes per file, folders, recent notes and search across every note.
- **MCP tools:** agents can read and write notes through Binary Ninja's MCP server, with per-note access control.
- **Enterprise:** concurrent edits to notes merge on sync.
- A view, a pane (with Sync groups) and a sidebar, and a short tour on first run.

## Embeds

Copy a link from the Symbols list or from Linear and Graph views:

![Copy BNURL to Function in the Symbols list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0cyn/notes/main/.github/images/copy-bnurl-symbols.png)

![Copy BNURL to Address in Linear view](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0cyn/notes/main/.github/images/copy-bnurl-linear.png)

Paste it into a note and it becomes an embed of the code there, or of the whole function:

![A whole-function HLIL embed in a note](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0cyn/notes/main/.github/images/function-embed.png)

Right-click an embed to choose its IL:

![Choosing an embed's IL from its context menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0cyn/notes/main/.github/images/embed-il-mode-menu.png)

## Finding notes

![The Notes home page: folders and search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0cyn/notes/main/.github/images/home-folders-and-search.png)

## Authors

![The author bar, with a line's authors shown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0cyn/notes/main/.github/images/author-bar.png)

Authorship is tracked line by line, and can be corrected by hand:

![Setting a line's author from the context menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0cyn/notes/main/.github/images/author-override-menu.png)
